title: Turn a requirement into a use case
work: Read OOAD pp. 4–8 and 15–16. Pick one campus app feature and describe who uses it and why.
output: One use case: actor, goal, main flow and one alternative.

title: Build a small enrolment database
work: Draw Student, Course and Enrolment. Add invented sample rows and try an INNER JOIN and a LEFT JOIN.
output: A three-table sketch and two queries with expected results.

title: Trace an algorithm by hand
work: Use an algorithm from class on five values. Record each step, then try it again on an empty or already sorted input.
output: A trace table and one sentence explaining an edge case.

title: Solve a finance example
work: Choose one worked example from Thursday. Cover the solution and redo it. For time value of money, match the rate period to the number of periods.
output: One worked answer with formula, units and an explanation.

title: Model a two-variable problem
work: Use a simple resource limit from class. Define the variables, objective and limits before doing any calculations.
output: A model with units, constraints and one feasible solution.

title: Make a computer admin cheat sheet
work: Summarise the week’s lecture and Friday lab, then test yourself without looking. Save the last 10 minutes for anything you missed.
output: A one-page recap and one question to ask next week.
